### 2026-11-14: Entry - 1

**5h**

Entry - 1
Nov 11 2026

Project : I Pod

Hey guys! Today i started and completed building my schematics. I thought this would be easy, because i got all the items needed, and I just need to search put the items and just need to put those appliances in but it wasn't easy because when i started i always had the parts in schematics, but here i didnt have those so i needed to just put the connect-06 and stuff like that so i could put the items into them when the pcb and board arrive.

i needed to connect many stuff to in the schematic it was exhausting with the fever i had and i was tired T^T

I learnt something new which is PWR_FLAG, this iss a dummy source which will tell the electrical rules checker that there is a electricity going there, but in real it isnt, it was really helpful when i was struggling not knowing what to do

I always put neat boxs around each component, but this time i didnt i thought the wire running around my pico and diode would be disturbed. i missed putting that, it would be cool
